skills.name: SQLMap validation: Account for baseline variability
skills.description: Avoid attributing ordinary response differences to SQL injection.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Compare the scan with a normal baseline and verify the application reached the intended handler.
2. Repeat only the same low-impact request when authorization and the test window permit.
3. Capture a small baseline set with the same account/request; compare normal variability with the SQLMap signal.
4. Do not use bypass, tamper, or evasion to force a result; report unresolved ambiguity.

Safety: stay within owner-authorized scope and use web.sqlmap with uthorized_target=true. Do not dump records, open shells, access server files, evade controls, or perform destructive actions.
